item.title: Rallying Cry – July 31, 2026
item.description: Today, the Archbishop of Canterbury is stepping up to support a £100m pledge for communities affected by enslavement, while Montana is moving forward with plans to become an experimental medical hub, and California has set a new world record by producing over half of its May electricity from solar power!
